menu_path_issues: Add a subscription from a file (EN and RU): WRONG path. 'Select file' / 'Выбрать файл' and 'Create empty' / 'Создать пустой' are NOT visible in the default Import Remote Config dialog. They render only when the profile type is Local (edit-info-modal.tsx:159-181). To get there: Profile Management > + > 'Advanced settings' / 'Дополнительные настройки' > 'Profile type' / 'Тип профиля' > 'Local' / 'Локальный' (common.local), then 'Select file' appears. The dialog title stays 'Import Remote Config'. The file picker accepts only yml/yaml (handleSelectFile), while drag-and-drop onto the Profiles page accepts .yml .yaml .json .jsonc .json5 .txt.

Choose server / delay test: WRONG location. 'Delay test' / 'Тест задержки' and 'Locate current node' / 'Найти текущий узел' are icon buttons (Gauge, LocateFixed) in EACH proxy-group card header (proxies.tsx:424-448), not in the page header. The page header holds only 'Collapse all/Expand all' (Свернуть все / Развернуть все) and 'Proxy group settings' (Настройки группы прокси). Selecting a node = click it inside an expanded group. 'Delay test all' (pages.proxies.delayTestAll) exists in the locale files but is unused in UI code.

View traffic / connections: 'Connections (sidebar) > Active' is imprecise. Default connectionListMode is 'process' (connection-setting-modal.tsx:43; connections.tsx:67), so the page first shows a process list ('Processes:' / 'Процессов:'); the Active/Closed tabs (Активные/Закрытые) appear only after opening a process (with a 'Back' / 'Назад' button) or after switching the list mode to 'classic' via the page's settings button.

Tray 'Outbound Mode > Rule Mode / Global Mode': the submenu parent label includes the current mode in brackets, e.g. 'Outbound Mode (Rule)' / 'Режим маршрутизации (Правило)' (tray.ts:276, strings tray.rule/tray.global). Submenu hidden when profile has globalMode === false (tray.ts:~253), same as the sidebar switcher.
Change language: dropdown order is 简体中文, English, Русский (use-language.ts:6-10), not English / Русский / 简体中文. Cosmetic only.

Toggle TUN / system proxy / Main Switch in RU: three Settings rows are easy to confuse. RU 'Режим TUN' is both the Main Switch tab (mainSwitchTun) and the TUN switch (sider.virtualInterface); RU 'Режим прокси' is both the Main Switch tab and the system-proxy switch (sider.proxyMode). In EN the TUN switch is 'Virtual Network Interface' but the tab is 'TUN Mode'. Instructions should say 'вкладка Основной переключатель > Режим TUN' vs 'переключатель Режим TUN ниже'.

Logs: 'Filter' / 'Фильтр' is a text-input placeholder (common.filter), not a button; Pause/Приостановить, Resume/Продолжить and Clear logs/Очистить логи are icon-only buttons with tooltip/aria-label (logs.tsx:95-120). Page header 'Real-time Logs' in EN, 'Логи' in RU confirmed.

Update-via-proxy / auto-update toggles: 'Auto update' / 'Автообновление', 'Update Interval (minutes)' / 'Интервал обновления (минуты)', 'Update via proxy' / 'Обновлять через прокси' sit inside the dialog's 'Advanced settings' block, not on the main import form (edit-info-modal.tsx:240-330).

Latest release is 1.5.0 published 2026-10-09; tag resolves to commit ee0db8e973e49c30991815175d167d1583d7aa1b (shallow clone of tag, read only, in a scratchpad temp dir).
Home page connect button has NO text label (icon only). Only the status text (Connected/Disconnected etc.) is a label. Do not tell users to press a button named 'Connect'.

Proxy mode: the UI offers only Rules and Global (sidebar switcher and tray). There is no selectable Direct mode; 'Direct mode' text (sider.directMode) is only a placeholder on Proxy Groups when mode is already direct. The switcher is hidden if the active profile has globalMode=false, and when no profile exists.
The word is 'Profile' / 'профиль' throughout, never 'subscription' as a menu name (only the URL field placeholder and the 'Subscription Address' field use 'subscription').

No QR code import, no QR display, and no Share / Copy subscription link action were found anywhere in src (grep for qr/share found nothing in UI). Deep link handling for clash://, mihomo://, koala-clash:// exists in src/main/index.ts:156-165 with no UI label.
Per-profile update and Profile Management '+' buttons are icon-only; the single-profile refresh has no text or tooltip key. Update all profiles has a title/aria-label.

EN and RU labels diverge for the same control: sider.virtualInterface is 'Virtual Network Interface' in EN but 'Режим TUN' in RU; the main switch tab is 'TUN Mode' / 'Режим TUN'. Also EN Logs page title 'Real-time Logs' vs sidebar 'Logs'.
Home status 'Connected' means TUN or system proxy enabled (home.tsx:125), not a tested tunnel handshake. The timer is HH:MM:SS with no label; up/down totals shown with arrow icons only.

Tray strings come from src/main/utils/i18n.ts (not the renderer locale files); the same-named keys tray.* in the renderer locales are not used for the tray (tray.showWindow returned undefined in renderer en/ru). RU tray strings verified in ruRU block.
Pluralised keys (pages.logs.newLogs_one/_other; RU _one/_few/_many) are in the locale as plural forms: 'N new logs' / 'N новых записей'.
RU locale is complete for all keys used above (no fallback to EN observed). Not checked: every one of ~1000 keys for parity; only keys on the flows above.
